definitions.explanation: A garden tool with prongs used for gathering leaves or loosening soil. Named for its resemblance to a bear's paw ({熊|くま}の{手|て}).
A decorated bamboo rake sold at Tori-no-Ichi festivals as a good-luck charm for business prosperity. The prongs symbolize raking in good fortune and wealth.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The ornamental {熊手|くまで} (sense 2) is a signature item of {酉|とり}の{市|いち} (Tori-no-Ichi), a festival held at shrines in November. Lavishly decorated with lucky symbols — treasure ships, coins, ⟦{招|まね}き{猫|ねこ}→招き猫：06538_manekineko⟧ — these rakes symbolize "raking in" good fortune and prosperity. Businesses and shop owners traditionally buy them to ensure a successful coming year. By custom, buyers start small and purchase progressively larger {熊手|くまで} each year.

The word literally means "bear's hand" (⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧ + ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧), describing the claw-like shape of the prongs.

- {熊手|くまで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to gather with a rake
- {熊手|くまで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to display a lucky rake
- {酉|とり}の{市|いち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{熊手|くまで}: Tori-no-Ichi lucky rake
- ⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧{熊手|くまで}: auspicious rake
